cn_steps: 启用 `PICO Neo3 Controller Keys`（模块 `PICONeo3ControllerKeys`）。
它定义 PICO Neo3 控制器的输入键（`PICONeo3_*` FKey），只依赖 InputCore。
无需 OpenXR 映射即可引用这些键（如 Pixel Streaming 场景）。
轻量按键定义插件；供需要这些键的模块引用。
en_steps: Enable `PICO Neo3 Controller Keys` (module `PICONeo3ControllerKeys`).
It defines PICO Neo3 controller input keys (`PICONeo3_*` FKeys), depending only on InputCore.
These keys can be referenced without OpenXR mapping (e.g. Pixel Streaming scenarios).
A lightweight key-definition plugin; referenced by modules that need these keys.
note_cn: PICO Neo3 控制器输入键定义（仅依赖 InputCore）。

cn_steps: 启用 `PICO Neo3 Controller`（模块 `PICONeo3Controller`）。
它为 PICO Neo3 控制器提供 OpenXR 支持：`/interaction_profiles/bytedance/pico_neo3_controller`（`XR_BD_controller_interaction`）及控制器网格。
在 Neo3 手柄的 OpenXR 项目里使用对应交互配置与可视化模型。
属 OpenXR 输入扩展；需 OpenXR 运行时。
en_steps: Enable `PICO Neo3 Controller` (module `PICONeo3Controller`).
It provides OpenXR support for PICO Neo3 controllers: `/interaction_profiles/bytedance/pico_neo3_controller` (`XR_BD_controller_interaction`) plus controller meshes.
Use the matching interaction profile and visualization meshes in Neo3 OpenXR projects.
It is an OpenXR input extension; requires an OpenXR runtime.
note_cn: OpenXR 的 PICO Neo3 控制器支持。

cn_steps: 启用 `Pippen`（模块 `Pippen`）。
它是引擎自带的 Pippen 插件（模块同名），用于该实验性功能的运行时。
在需要 Pippen 能力的项目里启用本插件，并按模块 API 接入。
属实验性/内部插件；接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable `Pippen` (module `Pippen`).
It is the engine-shipped Pippen plugin (same-named module) providing that experimental feature's runtime.
Enable it in projects that need Pippen capabilities and call into the module API.
It is an experimental/internal plugin; the contract may change across versions.
note_cn: 引擎自带的 Pippen 实验性运行时插件。

cn_steps: 启用 `PIX on Windows GPU Capture Plugin`（模块 `PixWinPlugin`）。
它把 Windows 上的 PIX 图形调试器接到引擎，便于 GPU 捕捉与分析。
在 Windows 开发机上配合 PIX 做帧捕捉，排查渲染问题。
属编辑器/开发者插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `PIX on Windows GPU Capture Plugin` (module `PixWinPlugin`).
It integrates the PIX graphics debugger on Windows for GPU capture and analysis.
Use it with PIX on a Windows dev machine to capture frames and triage rendering issues.
It is an editor/developer plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: Windows 上 PIX 图形调试器的 GPU 捕捉集成。

cn_steps: 启用 `Pixel Capture`（模块 `PixelCapture`、`PixelCaptureShaders`）。
它提供把像素缓冲区捕获成其它格式的框架，并允许生产/消费速率解耦。
常作为 Pixel Streaming 等推流管线的底层捕获层。
属媒体/推流基础库；一般随 Pixel Streaming 一起启用。
en_steps: Enable `Pixel Capture` (modules `PixelCapture`, `PixelCaptureShaders`).
It is a framework for capturing pixel buffers into other formats while allowing disconnected produce/consume rates.
Commonly the capture layer under Pixel Streaming and similar streaming pipelines.
It is a media/streaming foundation library; usually enabled with Pixel Streaming.
note_cn: 像素缓冲区捕获框架（生产/消费可解耦）。

cn_steps: 启用 `Pixel Streaming 2`（模块 `PixelStreaming2Core`、`PixelStreaming2`、`PixelStreaming2Settings`、`PixelStreaming2RTC`、`PixelStreaming2Servers`、`PixelStreaming2Editor`、`PixelStreaming2HMD`、`PixelStreaming2Input`）。
它把引擎音频与画面通过 WebRTC 推到浏览器等兼容播放器（Pixel Streaming 的新一代实现）。
配置信令/STUN，启动推流，用浏览器当薄客户端显示并回传输入。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`PixelStreaming2Editor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Pixel Streaming 2` (modules `PixelStreaming2Core`, `PixelStreaming2`, `PixelStreaming2Settings`, `PixelStreaming2RTC`, `PixelStreaming2Servers`, `PixelStreaming2Editor`, `PixelStreaming2HMD`, `PixelStreaming2Input`).
It streams engine audio and frames over WebRTC to compatible players such as a browser (the next-gen Pixel Streaming implementation).
Configure signaling/STUN, start streaming, and use a browser as a thin client for video plus input.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `PixelStreaming2Editor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 新一代 Pixel Streaming：WebRTC 推送引擎音视频到浏览器。
note_en: Next-gen Pixel Streaming: WebRTC of engine audio/video to browsers.

cn_steps: 启用 `Pixel Streaming Player`（运行时 `PixelStreamingPlayer`，编辑器 `PixelStreamingPlayerEditor`）。
它在引擎内作为 Pixel Streaming 的播放端，接收远端 WebRTC 画面。
用于在编辑器/关卡里预览或嵌入一路 Pixel Streaming 流。
属实验性播放端；需配合 Pixel Streaming 信令。
en_steps: Enable `Pixel Streaming Player` (runtime `PixelStreamingPlayer`, editor `PixelStreamingPlayerEditor`).
It is an in-engine Pixel Streaming playback client that receives a remote WebRTC video stream.
Use it to preview or embed a Pixel Streaming feed inside the editor/level.
It is an experimental player; requires Pixel Streaming signaling.
note_cn: 引擎内的 Pixel Streaming 播放端（收 WebRTC 画面）。
note_en: In-engine Pixel Streaming player (receives WebRTC video).

cn_steps: 启用 `Pixel Streaming`（模块 `PixelStreaming`、`PixelStreamingServers`、`PixelStreamingEditor`、`PixelStreamingBlueprint`、`PixelStreamingBlueprintEditor`、`PixelStreamingHMD`、`PixelStreamingInput`）。
它把引擎音频与画面通过 WebRTC 推到浏览器等兼容播放器（第一代 Pixel Streaming）。
配置信令服务器，启动推流，用浏览器当薄客户端显示并回传输入。
新项目可评估 `Pixel Streaming 2`；本插件仍用于既有云游戏/远程审阅流程。
en_steps: Enable `Pixel Streaming` (modules `PixelStreaming`, `PixelStreamingServers`, `PixelStreamingEditor`, `PixelStreamingBlueprint`, `PixelStreamingBlueprintEditor`, `PixelStreamingHMD`, `PixelStreamingInput`).
It streams engine audio and frames over WebRTC to compatible players such as a browser (first-gen Pixel Streaming).
Configure a signaling server, start streaming, and use a browser as a thin client for video plus input.
New projects may evaluate `Pixel Streaming 2`; this plugin still covers existing cloud-gaming/remote-review flows.
note_cn: 第一代 Pixel Streaming：WebRTC 推送引擎音视频到浏览器。
note_en: First-gen Pixel Streaming: WebRTC of engine audio/video to browsers.

cn_steps: 启用 `PlainProps`（模块 `PlainProps`）。
它是新序列化栈的原型核心（PlainProps）。
仅在评估/开发该序列化原型时启用，不要当生产序列化方案。
属实验性原型；接口可能随夜构建变化。
en_steps: Enable `PlainProps` (module `PlainProps`).
It is the core of the new serialization-stack prototype (PlainProps).
Enable it only when evaluating/developing that serialization prototype; not a production serialization path.
It is an experimental prototype; the contract may change on nightly builds.
note_cn: 新序列化栈原型的核心（PlainProps）。
note_en: Core of the new serialization-stack prototype (PlainProps).

cn_steps: 启用 `PlainPropsEngine`（模块 `PlainPropsEngine`）。
它把 PlainProps 新序列化原型接到引擎层对象（不是引擎 `Engine` 模块本身）。
与 `PlainProps` / `PlainPropsUObject` 一起评估该序列化栈。
属实验性原型；接口可能随夜构建变化。
en_steps: Enable `PlainPropsEngine` (module `PlainPropsEngine`).
It binds the PlainProps serialization prototype to engine-layer objects (not the engine `Engine` module itself).
Evaluate this serialization stack together with `PlainProps` / `PlainPropsUObject`.
It is an experimental prototype; the contract may change on nightly builds.
note_cn: PlainProps 序列化原型的引擎层绑定。
note_en: Engine-layer bindings for the PlainProps serialization prototype.

cn_steps: 启用 `PlainPropsUObject`（模块 `PlainPropsUObject`）。
它是新序列化栈原型的 CoreUObject 绑定。
与 `PlainProps` 一起用于 UObject 路径上的原型序列化。
属实验性原型；接口可能随夜构建变化。
en_steps: Enable `PlainPropsUObject` (module `PlainPropsUObject`).
It is the CoreUObject bindings for the new serialization-stack prototype.
Use it with `PlainProps` for prototype serialization on the UObject path.
It is an experimental prototype; the contract may change on nightly builds.
note_cn: PlainProps 序列化原型的 CoreUObject 绑定。
note_en: CoreUObject bindings for the PlainProps serialization prototype.

cn_steps: 启用 `Planar Cut`（模块 `PlanarCut`）。
它提供平面切割模块，用于按平面切开网格。
在几何处理/破碎相关流程里调用平面切割。
属实验性几何工具；接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable `Planar Cut` (module `PlanarCut`).
It adds a planar-cut module for slicing meshes with a plane.
Call planar cuts from geometry-processing/fracture-related flows.
It is an experimental geometry tool; the contract may change across versions.
note_cn: 按平面切开网格的平面切割模块。
note_en: Planar-cut module for slicing meshes with a plane.

cn_steps: 启用 `Plastic SCM`（模块 `PlasticSourceControl`）。
它提供 Unity Version Control（原 Plastic SCM）的源码管理集成。
在编辑器 Revision Control 里选 Plastic/UVCS，填写服务器后提交、同步、签出。
属编辑器源码管理插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Plastic SCM` (module `PlasticSourceControl`).
It provides Unity Version Control (formerly Plastic SCM) source-control integration.
Choose Plastic/UVCS in editor Revision Control, fill in the server, then submit, sync, and check out.
It is an editor source-control plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 编辑器里的 Unity Version Control（原 Plastic SCM）。
note_en: Unity Version Control (formerly Plastic SCM) in the editor.

cn_steps: 启用 `Platform Cryptography Plugin`（模块 `PlatformCrypto`、`PlatformCryptoTypes`、`PlatformCryptoContext`）。
它暴露统一加密 API：优先用平台原生加密，否则回退 OpenSSL。
在需要哈希/对称加密等能力时依赖这些模块，避免直接绑死某一库。
属实验性平台加密封装。
en_steps: Enable `Platform Cryptography Plugin` (modules `PlatformCrypto`, `PlatformCryptoTypes`, `PlatformCryptoContext`).
It exposes a unified crypto API: platform-native crypto when available, otherwise OpenSSL.
Depend on these modules for hashing/symmetric crypto instead of hard-wiring one library.
It is an experimental platform-crypto wrapper.
note_cn: 统一加密 API（平台原生，否则 OpenSSL）。

cn_steps: 启用 `Platform DLC`（模块 `PlatformDLC`）。
它提供对原生平台 DLC 的实验性支持（在支持的平台上）。
用它查询/装载平台商店 DLC，而不是自己接各平台 SDK。
属实验性平台 DLC；仅支持的目标有效。
en_steps: Enable `Platform DLC` (module `PlatformDLC`).
It provides experimental support for native platform DLC (on supported platforms).
Use it to query/mount store DLC instead of wiring each platform SDK yourself.
It is experimental platform DLC; only meaningful on supported targets.
note_cn: 原生平台 DLC 的实验性支持。
note_en: Experimental support for native platform DLC.
